summary: Station Butte lookout, Lane County, OR: 20-foot crow's nest and camp built about 1919, gone by 1958; county list says Abandoned. No source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Crow's nest and camp gone by 1958 per the register and firelookout.com; the FFLOS county list marks the site Abandoned instead.

events.note: Location used as a patrol lookout point (Oregon Lookouts history); no built structure mentioned
Crow's nest and camp, about 1919 per firetower.org; firelookout.com gives 1919
Panorama photographs from the lookout. firetower.org caption dates them 11-3-1936; Oregon Lookouts says November 3, 1938
Crow's nest and camp gone by 1958

evidence.supports: built about 1919; 20-foot crow's nest and camp; gone by 1958
evidence.quote: Built about 1919, this 20' crows nest and camp were gone by 1958.

evidence.supports: 1907 used as a patrol lookout point
evidence.quote: 1907: The location was used as a patrol lookout point.

evidence.supports: county list: Station Butte, Crowsnest, Abandoned

corrections.why: The FFLOS county list types the site Crowsnest, and firetower.org describes a 20-foot crow's nest and camp.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org and firelookout.com date the crow's nest to about 1919. Oregon Lookouts lists the location as a patrol lookout point in 1907. The story reports both.
Detail pages say gone by 1958; the county list says Abandoned. The story follows the detail pages and reports the list's label.
firetower.org caption gives 11-3-1936; Oregon Lookouts gives November 3, 1938. Not used in the story.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no staffing, access, or post-1958 sources found. Brief access 'unknown' is unresolved. The county list's Abandoned label may mean something is still on site, while the detail pages say gone; check before any visit note. Brief kind 'platform' is corrected to crowsnest per the county list. A scholarsbank thesis on Willamette lookouts returned only its title, so it was not used.
